descriptionChirho: To be destroyed, ruined, cut off, or to perish — the Nifal passive/reflexive sense indicating the subject undergoes destruction or annihilation, used of persons, peoples, and cities.
To cease, stop, or become still — the Qal intransitive sense indicating the cessation of an action or state.
To destroy or bring to ruin — the Qal transitive/active sense where the subject causes destruction of another, often with God as agent.
